en.name: CA 601 - Semi-automatic PVC Single Corner Cleaning Machine
en.description: CA 601 Single Corner Cleaning Machine used to clean lower and upper surfaces and outer corners of PVC profiles welded at 90° angle

STANDARD ACCESSORIES: 2 x cleaning cutters for white profiles
OPTIONAL ACCESSORIES: V type of cleaning cutter for white profiles
GENERAL FEATURES: High quality stripping and cleaning operations by means of the hydro-pneumatic system
Processing capability for maximum profile dimension: W130-H180 mm
Processing capability for minimum profile dimension: W30-H30 mm
Min. inner and outer square size according to W30 and W60 mm of profile width: L350 x L350 and L380 x L380 mm
Pneumatically working serial blade changing function that makes working easier
Fixing the workpiece firmly by means of the vertical and horizontal clamps
Centring system to fit the profiles properly on the setsquare
Stripping blade levels are adjustable according to laminated and unlaminated profiles
Single or multi cleaning operations can be processed
Automatic start up feature when profile placed on the table
Stops automatically after stripping and cleaning operation
